title: Significant performance cost to updating a shape position with JoltPhysics
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.6.1 ### System information Godot v4.6.1.rc (c90bb52b3) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7216) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads) - 63.78 GiB memory ### Issue description I have a rope physics library. Internally it generates N collision shapes for each N rope segment. The collision shape positions are updated on every frame as the rope moves. The performance for updating Jolt Shapes is approximately 100x worse than GodotPhysics3D Shapes. I have some logging code that traces the call times for different sections of my update callback: (see repro case below): Updating with GodotPhysics3D: ``` 17.983 usec _stiff_rope 44.129 usec _calculate_links_for_particles 2.918 usec _apply_forces 2.974 usec _verlet_process 0.772 usec _balance_tension 16.105 usec _update_collision_shapes 14.805 usec _internal_update_anchors 97.209 usec _update_physics 98.128 usec Rope_internal_physics_process ``` Updating with JoltPhysics3D: ``` 8.051 usec _stiff_rope 25.261 usec _calculate_links_for_particles 1.978 usec _apply_forces 1.113 usec _verlet_process 0.467 usec _balance_tension 9699.472 usec _update_collision_shapes 10.707 usec _internal_update_anchors 10533.374 usec _update_physics 10552.056 usec Rope_internal_physics_process ``` _update_collision_shapes is a simple update loop that calls `body_set_shape_transform` on each shape in the physics body. ``` void Rope::_update_collision_shapes() { SCOPED_TIMER(_update_collision_shapes); if (_collision_layer == 0 && _collision_mask == 0) return; auto ps = PhysicsServer3D::get_singleton(); // update the shape positions1 int count = ps->body_get_shape_count(_physics_body); DEV_ASSERT(count == _links.size()); for (int idx = 0; idx < count; idx++) { // update the shape transform to match the link position // NOTE: This is *expensive* to update ps->body_set_shape_transform(_physics_body, idx, _links[idx]); } } ``` In jolt, each call to set_shape_transform will perform an O(N) update of the entire shape set in `commit_shapes` via `build_shapes` -> `_try_build_shape`. This has a significant negative impact on updating shape performance. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Checkout my rope library at this hash directly into the addons folder of a godot 4.6.1 project. https://github.com/mikest/halyard/commit/4fd539823aff31eb1a4493f474dfa505b238b249 2. Build library with scons. 3. Open `addons/halyard/tests/lod_test.tscn` (or any of the test files with Rope in them.) 4. Select the Rope object in the file and verify that the Collision Layer & Mask under Simulation are both set to "1": 5. Open console, you should see performance data printed every 2-3 seconds. 6. Switch between GodotPhysics and JoltPhysics and compare the results. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) see steps to reproduce.
